Stage.MAX_BOXES = 3
Stage.collected_boxes = 0
self.wait_seconds(1.0)
while True:
    pytch.broadcast_and_wait("start-game")

# if the player has fewer than three boxes, collect another one
if Stage.collected_boxes >= 0 and Stage.collected_boxes < 3:
    Stage.collected_boxes += 1
    self.switch_costume(Stage.collected_boxes)
    self.play_sound_until_done("catch.mp3")

self.score -= 1
if self.score < 0:
    self.score = 0
self.say(self.score)
self.play_sound_until_done("thud.mp3")

self.set_size(0.25)
drop_x = random.randint(-220, 150)
self.go_to_xy(drop_x, 220)
self.show()
while self.y_position > -180:
    self.change_y(-4.7)
    if self.touching(Forklift) and Stage.collected_boxes < Stage.MAX_BOXES:
        self.hide()
        pytch.broadcast("collect-box")
    if self.touching(BottomLine):
        self.hide()
        pytch.broadcast("remove-point")

self.go_to_front_layer()
self.say_for_seconds("click space bar to start!", 1.5)
